name: tautchain
does: The taut chain (1, the default): on the ground a lighter drag and a taut creature pulled along at her pace and hurrying after her; up in the treetops pulling past a chain dips her and, kept up, brings her down; on foot, pulling on slides that sigil out of her stack and puts it down; a legend's chain yanks her back; links bigger by rank; every chain one magic-chain colour with its sigil's colour as a flash. 0: the chains as before. Sets tuning leash.chain.taut.on.
decision: Ed, 2026-11-12: "as you pull outside of the length you are progressively pulled down; if you stop pulling, you rise up again, only if you keep pulling do you actually fully switch back to ground mode"; "pop-out should also be gradual"; "legend chains yank you back instead of popping out"; "adult chains should look larger, and legend chains should look larger still"; "more generally 'magic chain' coloured, with the sigil colour as a occasional flash along it"; the old kept one switch away to A/B
